row.notes: Fills the press interview view-model for one question record: finds the player entrant id (list at +0x2e0/+0x2e8 of the object at screen+0x280->+0x88->+0x260), sets VM strings interviewer_name (handle screen+0x2e0) and question_text (screen+0x300, text id question+0x18 run through Career_Format_SponsorNameTokens), then shuffles answer indices with an MT19937 seeded from (screen+0x298)+0x280 and fills up to 4 answer slots (array screen+0x360, stride 0x288; nodes answer_%i with text, icon, icon_valid, answer_valid, handle_input, show_lock, is_enabled, Gated/Active/Selected/Confirmed/Opening, lock_type_icon, lock_level_requirement, lock_image=overrides.press_interviews.lock_icons[locked], unlocked) from the answer pointer list question+0x38..+0x40; answer+0x70 (1 or 2) selects a gate type and answer+0x74 the required level compared with a clamped stat at (screen+0x290)+0x2f0/+0x300; unused slots get answer_valid etc false, then calls FUN_141d42b80(screen). When question==0 it instead clears the vector screen+0x1028..+0x1030 (0x30-byte elems), zeroes screen+0x101e, sets bool nodes screen+0x2c0=true and screen+0xff8=false and dispatches a UI event by name (that path shares code with FUN_141d3e520). Caller 0x141d3bf40: looks up the player's interview record in the manager at screen+0x298, and if question index screen+0x2a8 is below the count fetches the next question (FUN_1410483b0), stores it at screen+0x2a0 and passes it here, else ends the interview. Good hook point to read or alter the question and answer choices shown. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
